title: A query measure can reference measures defined after it in the same DEFINE

source.quote: Definitions can reference other definitions that appear before or after the current definition.
source.supports: the order of the definitions does not matter
the division table gives REAL for CURRENCY / INTEGER

derivation: [Amt] = 540 and [Qty] = 15, both defined after [Avg Price]. 540 / 15 = 36. A fixed decimal divided by an integer is a double.
